features.name: Customer-Managed Encryption Key (CMK)
features.description: Functionality that allows customers to encrypt their Business Central environment database using their own encryption key stored in their own Azure Key Vault instead of using Microsoft-managed keys.
caveats: Requires a linked managed Power Platform environment
Unlinking environment reverts encryption to Microsoft-managed key
Copy or restore operations create new environments without CMK by default
Requires specific Microsoft 365 and Power Platform licensing beyond Business Central license
Setup should separate duties between key administrator and Dynamics 365/Power Platform administrator

features.name: Purge Protection on Key Vaults
features.description: A required setting that must be enabled on Key Vaults that contain keys used to encrypt Business Central environment databases.

features.name: Managed Environments Requirement
features.description: CMK requires the linked Power Platform environment to be a managed environment, which comes with specific licensing requirements beyond the Business Central license.
caveats: Requires additional Microsoft 365 and Power Platform licensing

features.name: Enterprise Policy Resource
features.description: A custom deployment resource on the Power Platform documentation that connects the encryption key to the Power Platform environment, which then connects to the Business Central environment.
caveats: Location must match Power Platform and Business Central environment region
Key ID must match the Key Vault resource ID

features.name: Power Platform Resource Provider Registration
features.description: The microsoft.powerplatform resource provider must be enabled for the Azure subscription before creating CMK Enterprise Policy resources.
caveats: Not enabled by default on Azure subscriptions

features.name: CMK Environment Unlinking Behavior
features.description: When an environment is unlinked after applying CMK, the Business Central environment automatically reverts to Microsoft-managed encryption keys.

features.name: CMK with Environment Copy and Restore
features.description: When copying or restoring a CMK-encrypted environment, the new environment is not automatically encrypted with the same customer-managed key and requires separate setup.
caveats: Requires linking to a new Power Platform environment and reapplying CMK

features.name: CMK Export and Storage Account Encryption
features.description: When exporting a CMK-encrypted environment, the backup file in the storage account is encrypted by default with Microsoft-managed keys, but can be re-encrypted with a customer-managed key.
